TED CRUZ.background: Born in Calgary, Alberta, Canada; family returned to the Houston area in 1974. Second Baptist High School; B.A. in public policy, Princeton University (1992); J.D., Harvard Law School (1995). In 2016 he called himself the only 'consistent conservative' in the field, and Jeb Bush called him a 'principled conservative.' Interest-group ratings place him at the conservative end of the Senate Republican conference: 100% from the American Conservative Union in 2013 and 2014, and a Club for Growth lifetime score of 93.

Won the 2016 Iowa caucuses and finished second to Donald Trump in delegates before suspending his campaign on May 3, 2016. On Jan. 6, 2021 he voted to sustain objections to Arizona's and Pennsylvania's electoral votes (rejected 93-6 and 92-7). In 2025 he drafted and led the TAKE IT DOWN Act and offered an amendment to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act for a decade-long moratorium on state AI regulation, which failed 99-1. Faced criticism for a February 2021 trip to Cancun during the Texas winter storm, which he later called a mistake. Chairs the Senate Commerce Committee (2025-2026).
